_meta.purpose: Curated regression inputs for the Homo vs AI prompt-evolution feature. When a new prompt revision is proposed, the harness runs both the BASE and PROPOSED prompts against these inputs and scores them on (a) keyword coverage, (b) length sanity, (c) markdown structure. The result helps the human reviewer decide whether to approve the revision without silently breaking previously-working flows.

scoring.must_appear: Each listed keyword must appear (case-insensitive, substring match) in the output to count as a hit. Score = hits / total_keywords.
scoring.min_chars: Output must be at least this many characters — guards against the AI collapsing into an apology or a one-liner.
scoring.max_chars: Output must be at most this many characters — guards against runaway verbosity that breaks the UI.
scoring.must_contain_markdown: Output must contain at least one markdown structural element (bullet list, numbered list, table, or heading) — guards against prose-only regressions on tasks where structured output is expected.

interpretation.pass: All criteria met for this sample.
interpretation.warn: must_appear partial (>=50%) OR length out of band but other criteria met.
interpretation.fail: must_appear <50% OR output empty / structure missing entirely.

_meta.note: Keep this list SMALL (3 samples per task) so the harness runs fast — workshop demos can't wait 30 seconds. Add more samples only after a real regression slipped through.
